name: hey-claude
description: Say "Hey Claude" to send a spoken prompt; hear a short spoken summary of each answer.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voice that reads answer summaries aloud: a name from the list in System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content > System Voice, such as Ava (Premium), Zoe (Premium), Samantha, Daniel or Karen. Premium and Enhanced voices sound best (download them under Manage Voices). Empty (the default), or a voice that is not installed, uses the system default.
